user.title: Scorebugs
user.description: Adds TV-style scorebugs to Home Assistant: a Scorebug card for any dashboard, and the bugs Glass Panes uses when it is installed. After adding it, open Configure to pick the teams you follow.

init.title: My teams
init.description: Following: {teams}. Each team you follow gets a sensor with its current game, and only the leagues of your teams are ever asked for scores.

data_description.logo_style: Which of the team's logos the scorebugs show. When a team has no logo of that kind, the closest one is used.
data_description.team: For golf, racing and UFC you can follow the whole event; for tennis, golf, racing and UFC you can follow one person from the current field.

team_logo.title: Team logo
team_logo.description: Pick the team whose logo you want to change.

team_logo_pick.title: Logo for {team}

data_description.file: Only for My own picture. Leave empty to keep the picture you used before, or to use one you put in /config/scorebugs/logos/ as {file_name}.

my_mark.title: Your own mark
my_mark.description: {now} Bugs show the Home Assistant logo where the TV network's logo was. A card or pane can show your own picture there instead (set its mark to **Your own picture**). Upload a PNG, WebP or JPG up to 2 MB; a clear background looks best. It stays on your Home Assistant, in /config/scorebugs/logos/ as {file_name}.

data_description.remove: Bugs set to your own picture then show the Home Assistant logo.

looks.title: Scorebug looks
looks.description: Pick which look to set: the overall one, or one team's. Automations and dashboards can change these too, with the Look entities (select.scorebugs_look and one per team).

look_pick.title: Look for {who}
look_pick.description: The bug the cards draw these games with. A card set to a bug of its own keeps it. When two of your teams play each other, the home team's look is used.

card_defaults.title: How bugs look on cards
card_defaults.description: Defaults for every Scorebug card (and Glass Panes panes). A card that sets one of these itself keeps its own.

abort.too_many: You follow 30 teams already. Remove one first.
abort.no_teams: Could not get that league's teams from ESPN right now. Try again in a minute.

error.not_image: That file isn't a PNG, WebP or JPG picture of 2 MB or less.
error.need_file: Upload a picture, or choose ESPN's logo.
error.need_mark_file: Upload a picture, or tick Remove my picture.
